description: This file contains implementations of quantized CUDA pooling operations, including max pooling with cuDNN support, and adaptive average pooling for quantized tensors. It includes functions for parameter checking, pooling execution, and registration of the max pooling operation within the quantized CUDA namespace.

classes.name: QMaxPool_arr_args<2>
classes.description: Template class for executing 2D quantized max pooling with cuDNN, registered as 'quantized::max_pool2d'.

methods.name: check_maxpool2d_params
methods.description: Checks validity of pooling parameters such as kernel size, stride, padding, and dilation.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool2d_quantized_cuda
methods.description: Performs quantized 2D adaptive average pooling on CUDA tensors, currently via dequantize and re-quantize.

methods.name: quantized_max_pool2d_cudnn
methods.description: Executes 2D max pooling on quantized tensors using cuDNN, handling 3D and 4D inputs, with parameter validation.
